summary: scripts/ci-local names the build admission log (BUILD_ADMISSION_LOG) from the account's home, beside BUILD_ADMISSION_STATE, so the cargo shim's slot-wait records inside the stages are written instead of failing under the stages' own HOME

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

compatibility.detail: Only on a host with the account's build-admission program: the stages see BUILD_ADMISSION_LOG, and a value the caller set is kept. ci-local is a lane file, so this changes linux-gate's lane definition digest.
